technologyDescriptionAndIncludedProcesse.value: PARAGRID geogrids are planar structures consisting of a biaxial array of composite geosynthetics strips. The strips comprise of a core of high tenacity polyester tendons encased in a polyethylene sheath. The manufacturing is performed in the West Yorkshire site (United Kingdom) by Linear Composites Ltd, a subsidiary of Officine Maccaferri S.p.A. The production process entails the extrusion of the polyethylene to coat a core material made of high tenacity polyester in order to obtain composite geosynthetic strips, which are then assembled through a thermo-bonding process to form a geogrid.

PARAGRID-Geogitter sind planare Strukturen, die aus einer biaxialen Anordnung von Geokunststoff-Verbundstreifen bestehen. Die Streifen bestehen aus einem Kern aus hochfesten Polyesterspanngliedern, die von einem Polyethylenmantel umhüllt sind. 
Die Herstellung erfolgt am Standort West Yorkshire (Vereinigtes Königreich) durch Linear Composites Ltd, einer Tochtergesellschaft der Officine Maccaferri S.p.A.. Das Herstellungsverfahren umfasst die Extrusion des Polyethylens zur Ummantelung eines Kernmaterials aus hochfestem Polyester, um Verbundgeokunststoffstreifen zu erhalten, die dann in einem Thermobondverfahren zu einem Geogitter zusammengefügt werden.

technologicalApplicability.value: PARAGRID is used as reinforcement in soil structures. The combination of the mechanical resistance of the polyester core with the durability of the polyethylene sheath enables its use in very aggressive conditions. Indeed, PARAGRID is highly resistant to chemicals, micro-organisms, UV radiation and mechanical damages.
